context_varying_parameters.name: age_distribution
context_varying_parameters.reason: Distinct eligibility, reported source moment/category anchors and unobserved target age structure require separate marginal families and parameters. No source age boundary or timing shift is inherited by target.

context_varying_parameters.name: sex_distribution
context_varying_parameters.reason: Source composition uses admitted counts without population weighting. Target fraction is an independent scenario assumption. Rounded quotas give both categories support.

context_varying_parameters.name: bmi_distribution
context_varying_parameters.reason: MIND reports total mean/SD whereas Ayele reports categories. Preserve each evidence type and explicitly supply unreported sex differences and tails. Target adiposity is not inferred from its hidden composition.

context_varying_parameters.name: glucose_baseline
context_varying_parameters.reason: Only MIND has an eligible continuous glucose marginal. Ayele and target persistent baseline values are explicit selection/population/assay transport choices, separate from meal and error additions.

context_varying_parameters.name: dependence
context_varying_parameters.reason: Age spans, selection and demographic composition may change age-adiposity dependence. Context-specific latent correlations are assumed; shared glucose loadings are a testable transport hypothesis.

context_varying_parameters.name: feeding
context_varying_parameters.reason: Source fasting serum, mixed capillary assessment and pooled target POC have distinct protocols. Nonfasting mixture fractions are unreported and specified as scenario values, with explicit conditional independence.

context_varying_parameters.name: measurement_model
context_varying_parameters.reason: Ayele uses a three-day average while target and MIND outputs are treated as single recorded measurements. Added error CVs and daily independence are assumptions; MIND baseline already incorporates recorded serum dispersion.
